invariants.rationale: The method returns a HoodieWriteMetadata object, so result should not be null.
preppedRecords is a parameter and expected to be non-null before method exit.
instantTime is a parameter and expected to be non-null.
Typically, upsertPrepped is called with records to upsert, so preppedRecords should not be empty upon method exit.
The write statuses list inside result should not be null after upsert operation.
